final_message:
The bug was in `render_invoice` in `billing/render.py`. The tax branch worked out the rate label and whether the tax was inclusive, then hit a leftover `pass` and never added a tax row to the output.

I replaced the `pass` so the invoice now gets a tax row. It reads `Tax (8.25%)` with the invoice's tax total, and gets an " included" suffix when the tax is inclusive. The " included" wording is my choice; the test doesn't cover it.

I added your test as `tests/test_render_tax.py`. The full suite passes (25 tests), and I wrote `answer.json` as `{"file": "render.py", "function": "render_invoice"}`.

steps.command: cd billing && cat render.py tax.py; ls

cd .. && python3 - <<'E'
p='billing/render.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("""        pass
""","""        suffix = " included" if inclusive else ""
        out.append(_row(label + suffix, format_amount(invoice["tax_total"], currency)))
""")
open(p,'w').write(s)
E
echo '{"file": "render.py", "function": "render_invoice"}' > answer.json
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5

cat > tests/test_render_tax.py <<'E'
from billing.render import render_invoice


def test_render_invoice(world):
    from billing import tax

    tax.set_tax_rate(world.ctx, "US-CA", 825, "CA")
    cus = world.customer(region="US-CA")
    world.engine.subscribe(cus["id"], [(world.monthly["id"], 1)])
    [inv] = world.engine.invoices_for(cus["id"])
    text = render_invoice(world.ctx, inv)
    assert "Invoice INV-00001" in text
    assert "Tax (8.25%)" in text
    assert "$10.82" in text
E
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5
